decision: R2 retains its sealed live free-space floor unchanged. After R2 has terminal independent verification, replace that retired R2-only floor with one Odyssey preflight reservation; do not reserve shared retained data twice.

measurement_at_2026_08_01.accounting_note: archive cache entries are hard links to the archive objects and consume zero additional physical bytes; both must be counted once.

shared_post_r2_capacity_policy.formula: runtime_free_floor + P95_total_measured_private_growth, where runtime_free_floor = 25_GiB_device_free_floor + explicit_model_storage_reserve + width_8*largest_measured_transient + terminal_allowance
shared_post_r2_capacity_policy.protected_dynamic_floor_policy: After verified R2, retain a fixed 25 GiB device-wide free-space floor. Do not derive a second percentage-of-volume reservation: Substrate is the primary storage consumer and the rest of the Odyssey envelope is measured at G07.
shared_post_r2_capacity_policy.protected_floor_is_shared_once: The historical sealed R2 floor is not changed. After R2 terminal verification, Odyssey uses one 25 GiB device floor; it is not added to an obsolete R2 floor or counted twice.
shared_post_r2_capacity_policy.model_storage_reservation_policy: A locally present, pinned model artifact is already reflected in df and has zero additional storage reserve. Reserve exact bytes only for a separately staged artifact not yet present; do not turn the 24 GiB model-service RAM cap into a duplicate disk reservation.
shared_post_r2_capacity_policy.odyssey_capacity_mode: G07 derives actual P95 growth from the eight-cell rehearsal and live preflight refuses if it no longer fits either observed dynamic capacity or the 120 GiB maximum private-write cap; the worker holds before the runtime floor is crossed.
shared_post_r2_capacity_policy.simultaneous_use_rule: Full Odyssey may be admitted only when the live launch formula passes. If a separately staged model artifact or another project consumes capacity, re-run preflight; do not borrow the device floor or silently change the full-program identity.
shared_post_r2_capacity_policy.private_write_cap_policy: G07-measured P95 growth bounded by a 120 GiB maximum private-write cap

output_optimization_policy.immutable_shared_inputs: reference manifest-pinned corpus objects in place; do not copy source media or archives into frontier roots
output_optimization_policy.content_addressing: store each private blob once by sha256 and record references in receipts; duplicate artifacts must be links, never second payloads
output_optimization_policy.checkpointing: two-hour delta checkpoints, twelve-hour full checkpoints, daily verified compaction; retain only the current full checkpoint plus its valid delta chain
output_optimization_policy.structured_receipts: canonical JSONL with content digests and aggregate telemetry; no duplicate pretty-printed status copies or unbounded debug logs
output_optimization_policy.media_derivatives: generate deterministic bounded derivatives only when required by a task; verify digest then remove transient work files before the next boundary
output_optimization_policy.rehearsal_requirement: the eight-cell rehearsal must measure P95 durable growth, the largest transient, and an observed dynamic capacity; P95 must remain at or below 120 GiB and the rehearsal cannot lower the 25 GiB device floor

shared_post_r2_capacity_policy.transient_allowance: measured in mandatory eight-cell rehearsal; no guessed value authorizes launch
shared_post_r2_capacity_policy.explicit_user_reserve: the 25 GiB device floor and 120 GiB maximum private-write cap are the standing storage bounds. A separately staged model artifact is additive only when it is not already represented in df; no model-ladder envelope is double-counted
shared_post_r2_capacity_policy.shared_lake_treatment: represented once by actual df free bytes; never added again as pending acquisition or private growth

transition_gate: public prefetch receipt finalized or cleanly paused at its floor
Odyssey source, custody, and task manifests sealed
prohibited: changing active R2 minimum free bytes
launching Odyssey based on this draft before its rehearsal and gates
